assumptions: Concept roots should be migrated in dependency-friendly order: project -> knowledge -> change -> GC -> session -> roadmap -> state/resume -> API/shared cleanup.
Resume-context and prompt belong under src/state/** because they are derived state/context packets; no separate src/resume/** root is needed.
Target root paths stay in acceptance criteria rather than roadmap code_paths until implementation creates them, keeping graph health green.
non_goals: No new decision row; accepted FS-ROOT-CONCEPTS decision remains the semantic source.
No public tool schema, package entrypoint, validation profile name, build/validation JSON schema, or product behavior changes.
No adapters/UI/skills migration except import updates required by concept-root moves.
No top-level infrastructure/core/engine roots and no broad shared dumping ground.
No UI/report surface task in this migration sprint unless user explicitly reprioritizes it.
risks: Eight-task sprint is high-risk migration work; each task requires implementation_build, fresh validation, task-close proof, and post-close GC dry-run where applicable.
Automatic task creation initially merged the cohort into TASK-023; that task is cancelled and split tasks must remain atomic.
Final API/shared cleanup depends on prior root migrations; do not start TASK-031 before prerequisite root tasks close unless planning is updated.

closure: Fresh implementation should start with TASK-024 and this planning build.
